title: GGUF on T4
plan_week: W5 (month 2 — the marketability pivot; month 1 was calibration)
hypothesis: The single most-asked question by people holding a free T4: which LLM actually runs locally on it, and how fast? Our claim: Qwen3-8B Q4_K_M is the sweet spot (fast, small enough to leave VRAM headroom), 14B fits but crawls by comparison, and gpt-oss-20b — the open model everyone wants — is borderline on 15 GB and either barely fits or OOMs. Nobody publishes this table; we measure it.
success_metric: For each of qwen3-4b/8b/14b Q4_K_M and gpt-oss-20b MXFP4: download_s, load_s, tg_tok_s (greedy decode), pp512_tok_s, VRAM after load and peak, and answer_ok sanity — harvested from timings.json with no browser. A skipped/OOM record on the two big models is an acceptable outcome and gets published as such.

gpu.gate: lab.quota.decide_gpu_job — 2h of an 8h cap; week reads 0.05h/30.00h at W5 start

eval.status: drafted this week, pushed after the measured table exists so grading thresholds come from timings.json, not guesses
